title: The Disciple: A Wu-Tang Fable
plot_overview: An outsider’s relentless determination helps him enter the inner circle of a prominent music group. As ambition and creativity come together, he becomes part of the making of an album poised to spark controversy around the world.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like stories about ambition, music, and outsiders finding their way into influential circles; Not for you if you prefer plots without controversy.
review_summary: Pros: determined outsider; music-world setting | Cons: controversy may feel heavy; limited context provided
